# 📱 App Store Assets & Submission Guide

## Required Assets Checklist

### 🎨 App Icons

#### iOS App Store (Apple)
- **App Icon (1024x1024px)** - Required for App Store listing
  - Format: PNG, no transparency
  - Color space: sRGB or P3
  - No rounded corners (Apple adds them automatically)
  
#### Google Play Store (Android)
- **App Icon (512x512px)** - Required for Play Store listing
  - Format: PNG, 32-bit with transparency
  - Color space: sRGB
  
#### In-App Icons (Auto-generated by Capacitor)
The following sizes are generated automatically from your source:
- iOS: 20x20, 29x29, 40x40, 58x58, 60x60, 76x76, 80x80, 87x87, 120x120, 152x152, 167x167, 180x180, 1024x1024
- Android: 48x48, 72x72, 96x96, 144x144, 192x192, 512x512

**Current Icons:**
- ✅ `/public/icon-192.png` (192x192)
- ✅ `/public/icon-512.png` (512x512)

### 📸 Screenshots

#### iOS Screenshots (Required Sizes)

**iPhone 6.9" (iPhone 16 Pro Max)**
- Size: 2868 x 1320 pixels (landscape) or 1320 x 2868 pixels (portrait)
- Required: 3-10 screenshots

**iPhone 6.7" (iPhone 15 Pro Max, 14 Pro Max)**
- Size: 2796 x 1290 pixels (landscape) or 1290 x 2796 pixels (portrait)
- Required: 3-10 screenshots

**iPad Pro 13" (6th Gen)**
- Size: 2752 x 2064 pixels (landscape) or 2064 x 2752 pixels (portrait)
- Required: 3-10 screenshots

**Recommended Screenshots to Capture:**
1. **Dashboard** - Show main interface with appointments and clients
2. **Booking Flow** - Demonstrate easy appointment booking
3. **Messaging** - Show client-stylist communication
4. **Formula Management** - Highlight AI-powered formula tracking
5. **Calendar/Schedule** - Display schedule management
6. **Portfolio** - Showcase stylist portfolio feature
7. **Client Discovery** - Show how stylists find clients

#### Android Screenshots (Required Sizes)

**Phone Screenshots**
- Size: 1080 x 2340 pixels (portrait) or 2340 x 1080 pixels (landscape)
- Required: 2-8 screenshots

**7-inch Tablet**
- Size: 1200 x 1920 pixels (portrait)
- Optional but recommended

**10-inch Tablet**
- Size: 1600 x 2560 pixels (portrait)
- Optional but recommended

### 🎥 Preview Video (Optional but Recommended)

**iOS App Preview:**
- Duration: 15-30 seconds
- Format: .mov, .m4v, or .mp4
- Orientation: Portrait or Landscape
- Resolution: Match screenshot dimensions

**Android Promo Video:**
- Duration: 30 seconds - 2 minutes
- Format: YouTube link
- Orientation: Landscape preferred

**Suggested Video Content:**
1. Open app (0-3s)
2. Show dashboard (3-6s)
3. Book appointment (6-12s)
4. View formula (12-18s)
5. Send message (18-24s)
6. End with branding (24-30s)

## 🚀 Submission Checklist

### Before Submitting to Apple

- [ ] App icon 1024x1024 created
- [ ] 3+ screenshots for each required device size
- [ ] App description written
- [ ] Keywords selected
- [ ] Privacy policy URL live
- [ ] Support URL live
- [ ] App Store Connect account created ($99/year)
- [ ] Test on physical iOS device
- [ ] No placeholder content or "TODO" text
- [ ] All features tested and working
- [ ] Privacy manifest configured (if needed)
- [ ] Age rating selected

### Before Submitting to Google Play

- [ ] App icon 512x512 created
- [ ] 2+ screenshots for phone
- [ ] App description written
- [ ] Privacy policy URL live
- [ ] Google Play Console account created ($25 one-time)
- [ ] Test on physical Android device
- [ ] Content rating questionnaire completed
- [ ] Target audience selected
- [ ] Data safety form completed
- [ ] App signing configured

---

## 📊 App Store Optimization (ASO) Tips

### Keywords Research
Focus on these high-volume, low-competition keywords:
- "hair salon booking"
- "stylist appointment"
- "color formula tracker"
- "salon management"
- "hair stylist app"
- "beauty booking"

### Visual Optimization
- First screenshot is the most important (80% of users only see this one)
- Use device frames with branded backgrounds
- Include benefit-driven text overlays
- Show the app solving a problem
- Use high-contrast, readable text

### Rating & Reviews
- Prompt users after a positive experience (successful booking)
- Respond to all reviews within 24 hours
- Address negative feedback quickly
- Use feedback to improve the app

---

## 🎨 Design Resources

### Tools for Creating Assets
- **Figma** - Free design tool (recommended)
- **Canva** - Easy templates for screenshots
- **Adobe Express** - Quick graphic creation
- **Screenshot.rocks** - Add device frames automatically

### Screenshot Templates
Use these Figma community templates:
- "App Store Screenshots Template"
- "iOS Screenshot Mockups"
- "Android App Screenshots"

### Icon Design Guidelines
- Keep it simple and recognizable at small sizes
- Use your brand colors (purple, pink, cyan)
- Avoid text (should be readable at 40px)
- Make it unique from competitors
- Test in both light and dark mode

## 🔍 Review Guidelines

### Apple Review Guidelines
Your app must comply with:
- **2.1 App Completeness** - No placeholders, must be fully functional
- **2.3 Accurate Metadata** - Description matches functionality
- **4.0 Design** - Professional UI, follows Human Interface Guidelines
- **5.1 Privacy** - Privacy policy required, proper data handling

**Common Rejection Reasons:**
- Incomplete app information
- Broken links or features
- Misleading screenshots
- Missing privacy policy
- Crashy or buggy experience

### Google Play Policies
Your app must comply with:
- **Restricted Content** - No prohibited content
- **Intellectual Property** - No trademark violations
- **Privacy** - Privacy policy required, data handling disclosed
- **Monetization** - Clear pricing, no deceptive practices

**Common Rejection Reasons:**
- Missing privacy policy
- Unclear data usage
- Crashy or buggy experience
- Incomplete store listing

## 📅 Timeline Estimate

**Week 1: Asset Creation**
- Day 1-2: Create app icons
- Day 3-5: Capture and edit screenshots
- Day 6-7: Write descriptions and metadata

**Week 2: Submission**
- Day 1: Set up developer accounts
- Day 2-3: Upload to App Store Connect & Play Console
- Day 4-5: Submit for review
- Day 6-14: Apple review (average 1-2 days)
- Day 6-7: Google review (average 1-2 hours)

**Total Time:** 2-3 weeks from start to approval

---

## 💡 Pro Tips

1. **Submit to Google Play first** - Review is faster, get early feedback
2. **Use TestFlight** - Beta test with real users before official launch
3. **Prepare press kit** - Have assets ready for media coverage
4. **Plan launch day** - Coordinate marketing, social media, email
5. **Monitor reviews** - Respond quickly to early feedback
6. **Update regularly** - Monthly updates signal active development
